metadata.description: Curated provenance-backed natural and meteorological event registry for contextual complaint evaluation

primary_sources.name: India Meteorological Department (IMD), Ministry of Earth Sciences
National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA), Ministry of Home Affairs

events.source_reference: IMD Report on Cyclonic Disturbances Over North Indian Ocean 2019 (Report No. RSMC/2019)
events.description: Category 5 equivalent landfall near Puri with peak sustained surface winds of 175-185 kmph, causing widespread tree felling, transmission damage, and heavy coastal precipitation.

events.source_reference: IMD Cyclone Warning Division Bulletin - Super Cyclonic Storm Amphan (May 2020)
events.description: Super cyclonic storm crossing West Bengal coast over Sundarbans with recorded storm surges of 4-5 meters and gusts up to 185 kmph.

events.source_reference: IMD Cyclone Warning Division Summary Report - ESCS Tauktae (May 2021)
events.description: Extremely severe cyclonic storm with landfall near Tad Maidan (Gir Somnath) with sustained winds of 160-170 kmph, resulting in significant civic infrastructure damage and coastal inundation.

events.source_reference: IMD Cyclone Yaas Summary Report (RSMC New Delhi, 2021)
events.description: Very severe cyclonic storm making landfall south of Balasore with widespread rainfall exceeding 200 mm and riverine saline ingress in low-lying coastal tracts.

events.source_reference: IMD Preliminary Report on ESCS Biparjoy Over Arabian Sea (June 2023)
events.description: Long-lived cyclonic system crossing Saurashtra and Kutch coast near Jakhau Port with heavy to very heavy rainfall exceeding 250 mm in 24 hours across Kutch district.

events.event_name: North India Severe Monsoon Rainstorm & Flash Floods
events.source_reference: NDMA Monsoon Situation Report 2023 / IMD Extreme Rainfall Bulletin July 2023
events.description: Active Western Disturbance combined with monsoon surge resulting in record 24-hour rainfall (>250 mm), catastrophic landslides, and road connectivity washouts in the Beas basin.

events.source_reference: IMD Heavy Rainfall & Cyclone Michaung Special Bulletin (December 2023)
events.description: Quasi-stationary coastal movement generating extreme torrential rainfall (>400 mm in 48 hours) resulting in severe urban waterlogging and structural inundation in the Chennai metropolitan region.

events.source_reference: IMD Special Tropical Weather Outlook for Cyclone Remal (May 2024)
events.description: Severe cyclonic storm making landfall over Sundarbans with sustained wind speeds of 110-120 kmph, heavy rainfall, and embankment breaches.
